question: The average age of five person is 28 yrs. If one of them is excluded the average decreases by 2 yrs. The age of the excluded person in yrs is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

After excluding a person the average age decreases by 2

A = Old Avg + (Decrease in Avg) × New no. of terms

Where, A = Age of excluded person

⇒ A = 28 + (2) × 4 = 28 + 8 = 36 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of age of five person = 28

Average age after exclusion of 1 person = 26 

**Formula used:**

Average =(Sum of values)/(Total number of values)

**Calculation:**

Sum of age of five person = 28 × 5 = 140 

Sum of age of four numbers = 26 × 4 = 104 

Age of excluded person = 140 – 104 = 36 

**∴ The age of the excluded person is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

After excluding a value, if the average increases

Excluded = Old Avg + (Increase in Avg) × New no. of terms
